props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

props.name: offset
props.description: Where the badge's centre sits, measured from the avatar's top-left: `[x, y]`. Numbers are px; strings are any CSS length, and percentages are of the avatar's size, so `["100%", 0]` is the top-right corner at every size. Omit it to keep the default bottom-right spot.

props.name: presence
props.description: The default dot's status light: online (the default), busy, error, offline or external. Ignored when `render` draws its own indicator.
